title: Automotive Project/Release Manager
description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Domain & Platform Experience

• Experience with automotive software or infotainment systems

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics


Accessibility & UX Awareness

• Experience with accessibility, usability, or inclusive design

• Familiarity with accessibility standards or legal requirements (any domain)


Advanced Release / Engineering Exposure

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, build, test, and deployment processes

• Release engineering or DevOps collaboration experience

• Experience supporting stabilization, bugfix-heavy, or late-stage products

• Experience coordinating cross-team dependencies


Environment & Collaboration

• Comfort operating across time zones

• Experience in environments with high expectations and low tolerance for failure


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience in requirements & test case

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.


FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.


We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.


What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil


How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

Sediado em Belo Horizonte, você será responsável por gerir uma equipe de especialistas forenses e supervisionar investigações de crimes financeiros complexos, incluindo conflitos de interesse, fraudes em compras e suprimentos, apropriação indébita de ativos, má gestão financeira, corrupção e suborno.


Sua função será focada primordialmente na liderança da equipe, definindo objetivos estratégicos de desempenho e construindo relacionamentos para garantir a fluidez das operações regionais. Você terá a responsabilidade diária pela gestão dos especialistas forenses, fornecendo orientação para o desenvolvimento de carreira e supervisionando a alocação de recursos. Além disso, você será o principal ponto de contato para a gestão operacional, desempenhando um papel fundamental na estratégia geral dos objetivos de investigação do grupo.


Somado às funções de liderança, você conduzirá projetos de investigação corporativa de alto nível, ministrará treinamentos de conscientização sobre fraudes e supervisionará a integração de ferramentas de análise de dados (data analytics) nos fluxos de trabalho investigativos.


Para ter sucesso nesta função, é fundamental possuir sólida experiência na condução de investigações corporativas complexas e na gestão de equipes forenses especializadas. Provavelmente, você já atua em um cargo de gerência em uma consultoria forense ou em uma função similar no setor corporativo.

Embora a certificação CFE seja muito bem-vinda, valorizamos sua capacidade comprovada de liderar equipes de alto desempenho e gerenciar o relacionamento com stakeholders seniores.


Excelentes habilidades de comunicação são essenciais, sendo obrigatória a fluência em português e inglês. Conhecimento em espanhol e experiência com ferramentas avançadas de análise de dados serão considerados diferenciais significativos

title: Pessoa Estagiária em Inteligência de Negócios
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar nos processos de Gestão da Inadimplência (recebimento de informações dos shoppings, consolidação de dados e indicadores, análises pontuais solicitadas pela Diretoria)
  • Apoiar na construção de planilhas e materiais para realização de treinamentos junto aos shoppings
  • Apoiar a construção de especificação dos projetos na área como programas de engajamento, construção de ferramentas, atualização e melhorias nos processos existentes
  • Atuar de forma pró-ativa com as demais áreas (Jurídico, CSC, Régua de Cobrança, Faturamento, TI, Contas a Receber, Fornecedores e etc)
  • Apoiar na construção e atualização de Calendários, rotinas e rituais da área
  • Apoiar no atendimento de dúvidas, solicitações dos shoppings ao time de Inteligência de Negócios

Requisitos e qualificações


  • Superior cursando em Administração, Economia, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento intermediário no Pacote Office, sendo Excel e ferramentas de BI considerados diferenciais.

description:

Atividades:

- Participar da elaboração de manuais de rotinas ou POPs, junto com as áreas de CCIH, Qualidade e Educação Continuada, a fim de contribuir para a implantação de processo de melhores práticas de assistência hospitalar;

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer (LLM & AI Integration)


As a Software Engineer specializing in LLM Integration, you’ll be responsible for owning our AI infrastructure, agentic workflows, and the integration of Large Language Models into our core product. You’ll design and implement end-to-end AI features that empower our users and internal teams to leverage generative intelligence. You will maintain a scalable production environment using frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex and ensure that model outputs are accurate, secure, and performant. This role is perfect for someone who combines traditional software engineering rigor with a passion for the evolving AI landscape.


What You'll Do

AI Infrastructure & LLM Development

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable services that interface with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).
  • Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ground model responses in proprietary data.
  • Build and optimize backend APIs and microservices to support AI-driven features.
  • Develop robust prompt engineering strategies and evaluation frameworks to ensure output quality.
  • Document AI system architecture, model versioning, and integration patterns.

Product Integration & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to define user-facing AI capabilities.
  • Translate complex business requirements into technical AI solutions (e.g., automated support, intelligent search, or content generation).
  • Optimize model latency and token usage for cost-effective and snappy user experiences.
  • Support front-end teams in delivering seamless AI interactions.

Data Engineering for AI

  • Write and optimize SQL queries and vector database schemas (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus).
  • Implement data preprocessing and embedding pipelines to prepare unstructured data for LLM consumption.
  • Establish best practices for fine-tuning models or managing few-shot learning datasets.
  • Monitoring & AI Ops
  • Monitor LLM performance, \"hallucination\" rates, and API health proactively.
  • Implement guardrails, moderation layers, and validation processes for AI safety.
  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services and manage model deployments.
  • Stay updated on the latest research in NLP, LLM orchestration, and agentic frameworks.


What You'll Bring

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in Software Engineering, Backend Development, or AI/ML Engineering.
  • Strong Python proficiency, specifically in building scalable backend systems and working with asynchronous programming.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Haystack.
  • Solid understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, and embedding techniques.
  • Proven ability to work with RESTful APIs and Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to ship production-grade software features.


Key Skills

  • Problem Solver: Analytical thinker who can debug complex, non-deterministic AI behaviors.
  • Communicator: Excellent skills for explaining technical AI constraints to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-Starter: Ability to take ownership of the AI roadmap in a fast-paced environment.
  • Detail-Oriented: Commitment to software craftsmanship, code quality, and AI safety.


Nice to Have

  • Advanced experience with Vector Databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Qdrant).
  • Familiarity with LLM Evaluation tools (Ragas, TruLens, or LangSmith).
  • Experience with deployment orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or Serverless functions).
  • Knowledge of fine-tuning techniques and libraries like Hugging Face transformers or peft.
  • Prior work in a startup environment where rapid prototyping and iteration are key.


Why Join Us?

You’ll play a critical role in defining our AI strategy from the ground up. We offer a flexible, fully remote work environment where you’ll have the autonomy to choose the best tools for the job and make a massive impact on our product’s evolution. Your work will directly define how our customers interact with the next generation of intelligent software.

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Application Support Specialist
description:
AppXite is a product software development company, based in Riga, Latvia. Our Platform is an AI-Ready Digital Marketplace, CPQ & Billing Platform for Telco, SaaS, Cloud, and AI services. It enables partners to build and monetize as-a-service offerings with flexible pricing models. The platform includes pre-built vendor and catalog integrations with major providers like Microsoft, Google, AWS, Adobe, and VMware. It supports various billing configurations, helping partners effectively manage and grow their businesses.

About the role:   

We are seeking a dedicated Support Specialist for our largest global customers. You will undergo initial training in our platform, but should already possess qualifications necessary for the role. We’re looking for someone to grow with us in a remote position, working North America hours on a long-term B2B basis.

Your mission:   

  • Technical support and troubleshooting.  
  • Operational support tasks in the Application Support team working with Microsoft Cloud technologies .  
  • Experience with Microsoft CSP (Cloud Solution Provider) support and partner ecosystem processes.
  • Scope a customer issue by collecting the relevant facts and investigating the problem by doing his own research and by involving other teams as needed.  
  • Consult and collaborate with peers or colleagues around the world and with management and engineering to resolve service issues.  
  • Act internally as a customer/reseller advocate.  
  • Empower customers/resellers to find information, self-solve when they decide to, and learn more about Microsoft products, services, and support.  
  • Advise customers on how to gain additional value from their Microsoft products.  
  • Document technical work and research to help your colleagues to improve the product, and improve the support experience.  
  • Maintain a proactive approach to customer happiness, identifying customer satisfaction concerns and managing customer expectations.  
  • Having ownership of tasks, proactively following upon them, and ensuring fast resolution.  

That's you:   

  • Previous Support experience in IT.  
  • Strong SQL skills: ability to connect the database, ability to execute and create SQL queries.  
  • Hands-on experience working with APIs .  
  • Certified within Azure and/or M365 certification roadmap (e.g., Azure Fundamentals, Azure Administrator, Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals or Associate level).
  • Fluent English (verbal and written).  
  • Experience with Microsoft Cloud technologies (Azure) .  
  • Experience with troubleshooting SaaS application is a plus.  
  • Experience with licensing and invoices is a plus.  
  • Experience with MS partner center or similar administrator portals is a plus.  
  • Ability to identify, update and create Help Center articles to assist team members and external users with navigating and using a product.  
  • Ability to work as part of a team.  
  • Ability to make quick decisions, align priorities and execute tasks.  
  • Be able to stay calm under pressure.  
  • Ability to communicate well and precisely.  


Why join AppXite:

  • Remote-First Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a fully remote role.
  • Work With Global Tech Leaders: Collaborate on solutions used by some of the biggest names in the industry, including Adobe, AWS, Cisco, Google, IBM, Microsoft, Lenovo, and Liquid. Your work will help shape how these companies deliver services across the globe.
  • Skilled, International Team: Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We value technical excellence, clear communication, and mutual support.
  • Professional Development: Advance your skills with access to Microsoft certifications and continuous learning opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy four weeks of paid vacation per year, plus paid public holidays.
  • Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team - our employee referral program recognizes and rewards your contributions.


Join AppXite Platform Engineering team and work with a talented group of engineers building out next-generation technologies!

title: Elementor Expert (WordPress Website Builder)
description:
We are looking for a skilled WordPress developer with strong Elementor experience to join our team and build high-performance websites for our marketing agency clients.


This role focuses on executing a proven build process , not designing sites from scratch. You’ll work from established Elementor Pro templates while inserting pre-generated content and images created by our internal AI systems.


If you enjoy working within clear systems and take pride in building clean, fast, and polished websites , this role will be a great fit.



Responsibilities


  • Build 3–4 WordPress websites per week using pre-built Elementor Pro templates
  • Insert AI-generated content into website layouts (all content is provided)
  • Adjust layouts and design elements to tailor each template for the client
  • Generate website visuals using AI image tools based on supplied prompts
  • Create simple design assets when needed using Canva
  • Integrate WooCommerce functionality for ecommerce websites
  • Ensure each website achieves extremely fast page load speeds (under 1 second)
  • Follow documented build processes and workflows precisely



Required Skills & Experience


  • Advanced proficiency with Elementor and Elementor Pro
  • Strong knowledge of WordPress performance optimization
  • Experience configuring WooCommerce within Elementor websites
  • Familiarity with AI image generation tools (Midjourney, DALL-E, OpenAI, etc.)
  • Basic graphic design ability and experience with Canva
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Available during EST business hours
  • Highly organized and comfortable working within defined processes



What This Role Focuses On


This role is about efficiently producing high-quality websites using a repeatable system .


You will not be responsible for writing content or designing full websites from scratch. Our automation tools generate the text and provide prompts for images. Your job is to assemble the site using templates, produce visuals, refine the layout, and ensure the final result is clean, professional, and extremely fast.



Important Note


⚡ Performance is critical.

Every site must achieve full page load speeds under 1 second without relying on caching solutions.


If you do not have strong experience optimizing WordPress for speed, this role will not be a good fit.



What We Provide


  • Managed hosting accounts
  • Elementor Pro licenses
  • AI-generated content for every site
  • Image prompts for generating visuals
  • Detailed documentation and build processes
  • A steady pipeline of website projects


Full-time role

Working hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (±1 hour flexibility)



Who We’re Looking For


The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, efficient, and process-driven . You take pride in producing polished work, enjoy following clear systems, and understand how small optimizations can dramatically impact website performance.


You’re comfortable using modern tools like AI image generators, you work quickly without sacrificing quality, and you care about delivering websites that are both visually clean and technically fast .

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

• Definir, acompanhar e melhorar métricas de qualidade: recuperação (recall/precision, nDCG), factualidade, utilidade, segurança, latência e custo por requisição.

• Elaborar e refinar engenharia de prompts em cenários complexos, com guardrails e práticas de segurança contra prompt injection, exfiltração e jailbreaks.

• Sólida base em Estatística, Probabilidade e ML (regressão, classificação, clusterização) e desenho experimental. Experiência prática com LLMs, engenharia de prompts, embeddings e RAG em produção.

• Python avançado para análises, prototipação e serviços; SQL avançado e engenharia de dados aplicada (ETL/ELT).

• MLOps/LLMOps: experiment tracking (MLflow, W&B ou equivalente), versionamento de dados/modelos/prompts, observabilidade (tracing, custo, latência) e boas práticas de CI/CD.

• Capacidade de comunicar resultados complexos a públicos técnicos e de negócio; experiência prévia como arquiteto de soluções ou líder técnico em projetos de IA.

• Conhecimento em Airflow.


Diferenciais:


• Evals automatizados e guardrails: Ragas, DeepEval, PromptFlow/Promptfoo, LangSmith, NeMo Guardrails, Truera, Rebuff.

• Experiência com IA aplicada ao setor público ou jurídico, incluindo OCR/NLP jurídico e normalização de documentos processuais.

• Contribuições em InnerSource/open source, publicações e talks em comunidades técnicas.

• Otimização de custo/performance de LLMs e técnicas avançadas de RAG (query rewriting, reranking, recuperação híbrida, agentes).

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.


Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Gerente de Projetos de Infraestrutura e Segurança #992612
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Detalhes do Projeto

Consultor Funcional SAP MM com forte capacidade analítica e conhecimento de processos de suprimentos e gestão de materiais. Será responsável pelo mapeamento funcional de dados oriundos de transações Standard e Z (aproximadamente 70 transações), fornecendo direcionamento estruturado ao time ABAP para desenvolvimento de extratores e disponibilização das informações para fins analíticos e integrações.


Detalhes do projeto :

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos Pleno com experiência em Infraestrutura de TI e Segurança da Informação, para atuar em regime 100% remoto. O(a) profissional será responsável pela governança de fornecedores, acompanhamento de projetos simultâneos e consolidação de relatórios estratégicos para a diretoria.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

- Elaboração de relatórios executivos que apontam vulnerabilidades identificadas em sistemas, aplicações, nuvem e desenvolvimentos internos.

- Análise de riscos de exposição e consolidação das falhas encontradas, destacando impacto e urgência.

- Acompanhamento das correções junto aos responsáveis pelas aplicações e infraestrutura, cobrando prazos e garantindo execução das ações necessárias.

- Governança de fornecedores: monitorar contratos, SLAs e reuniões periódicas para assegurar cumprimento das entregas.

- Apresentação quinzenal de reports para a diretoria, com status das vulnerabilidades, riscos e andamento das correções.

- Gestão de múltiplos projetos simultâneos (3 a 5 em média), equilibrando governança de segurança e infraestrutura.

- Suporte aos projetos conduzidos por terceiros, garantindo alinhamento com processos internos e prazos definidos.

- Controle financeiro e de terceiros envolvidos nos projetos, assegurando conformidade e eficiência.

- Aplicação de metodologias ágeis (SCRUM/PMI) para organizar e acompanhar atividades de segurança e infraestrutura.

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce OEM Developer to design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce-based products using Salesforce’s OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) platform. This role requires deep expertise in Salesforce application development, second-generation managed packages, and modern Salesforce development practices, including a thorough and practical understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits and how to design within them.


Along with our partner, we are seeking a candidate who combines strong engineering skills with deep Salesforce administrator-level knowledge to deliver secure, performant, and upgrade-safe managed solutions deployed across multiple customer orgs.


Key Responsibilities:

Salesforce OEM & Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce OEM solutions using second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Build scalable, upgrade-safe features aligned with Salesforce OEM and ISV best practices
  • Implement application logic using Apex, SOQL, and SOSL, with careful consideration of platform constraints
  • Design solutions that efficiently operate within Salesforce governor limits, including limits related to CPU time, heap size, queries, DML, and concurrent execution
  • Develop modern user experiences using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and the Lightning framework
  • Ensure package versioning, dependency management, and release processes follow Salesforce standards


Platform Configuration & Administration

  • Apply deep Salesforce admin knowledge to design effective, maintainable configurations that complement custom code
  • Build and maintain Flows (record-triggered, screen flows, orchestration), ensuring automation is performant and governor-limit aware
  • Configure and manage profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, roles, and sharing rules
  • Design and maintain page layouts, Lightning Record Pages, and UI customizations
  • Evaluate and balance declarative vs. programmatic solutions to minimize technical debt and reduce risk of governor limit violations


Source Control & DevOps

  • Use Git for source control, including branching, merging, and pull request workflows
  • Collaborate within CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments (e.g., scratch orgs, packaging orgs, automated testing)
  • Support release management processes for managed packages across multiple versions and customers


Quality & Collaboration

  • Write comprehensive unit tests to ensure high code coverage and validate behavior under governor limit constraints
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex performance and limit-related issues across customer environments
  • Collaborate with product, architecture, QA, and support teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions
  • Contribute to technical documentation and Salesforce OEM best practice guidelines


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience developing on the Salesforce Platform, particularly with hands-on experience with Salesforce OEM development.
  • Proven experience building and maintaining second-generation managed packages (2GP)
  • Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs
  • Thorough understanding of Salesforce platform governor limits, including how they impact:

○Apex execution

○Flows and declarative automation

○Bulk processing and data volume

○Multi-tenant OEM applications

  • Deep Salesforce administrator-level expertise, including:

○Flow and declarative automation tooling

○Security and permissions modeling

○Page layouts and Lightning Record Pages

○Data modeling and configuration best practices

  • Experience using Git for source control in collaborative development environments
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data access patterns, and scalable design principles
  • Hold a Platform App Builder Certification is a valuable plus!


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build and scale advanced Salesforce OEM products that power multi-tenant enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Veterinarian
description:
About SignalPET


SignalPET is a fast-growing veterinary AI company working alongside veterinarians and radiologists to deliver faster, more accurate diagnostic support. Our mission is to enhance clinical decision-making through intelligent technology grounded in real-world veterinary medicine.


We are expanding our Medical R&D team in Brazil and are looking for a clinically strong, detail-oriented veterinarian to help build and refine the medical intelligence powering our platform.


The Role


As a Veterinarian – Medical Education & Medical Content , you will transform real SignalPET clinical cases into structured educational modules and high-quality medical marketing content.


You will help build and execute the SignalPET Training Hub & Academy , including CE-accredited learning modules, case-based training, and medical campaigns that strengthen veterinarians’ radiology skills and reinforce SignalPET’s clinical authority.


This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role working closely with:


  • Board-certified radiologists
  • Medical R&D
  • AI and Product teams
  • Marketing


Key Responsibilities


Academy & CE Content Development


  • Develop structured, case-based learning modules using real SignalPET cases
  • Create CE-accredited courses, micro-learning sessions, pathology refreshers, and interactive quizzes
  • Build AI vs. Radiologist comparison educational insights
  • Work with specialists to validate medical accuracy
  • Manage and publish modules inside the Training Hub platform


Medical Marketing Content


  • Write clinically authoritative blogs, case spotlights, white papers, landing page content, and educational campaigns
  • Develop product-related medical materials and sales enablement tools
  • Collaborate with marketing to align messaging and positioning
  • Ensure scientific credibility through specialist validation


Workflow-Connected Learning


  • Map common clinical findings (e.g., splenic masses, thoracic disease, trauma cases) to relevant Academy modules
  • Collaborate with AI and Product teams to connect case workflows with learning opportunities


Performance & Optimization


  • Define and track CE engagement, learning participation, and content performance metrics
  • Continuously refine modules based on user feedback and clinical data


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Participate in relevant internal meetings
  • Provide medical clarification for marketing and product initiatives
  • Coordinate with specialists and Medical R&D for content validation


Requirements


  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) or equivalent
  • Clinical Experience - Hands-on experience in small animal practice
  • Strong radiographic interpretation skills (canine & feline)
  • Radiology-focused experience is a plus
  • Excellent English writing skills (medical & educational content)
  • Ability to translate complex medical topics into clear, structured content
  • Experience creating CE-accredited content is a strong advantage
  • Strong small animal radiology knowledge
  • Ability to collaborate with board-certified specialists
  • Understanding of adult learning principles
  • Comfortable working in CMS and digital platforms


Working Hours


  • Monday to Friday - 7am to 4pm


*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.



Why Join SignalPET?


  • Work at the intersection of veterinary medicine and AI
  • Impact thousands of veterinary professionals globally
  • Remote flexibility
  • Be part of a growing, mission-driven team

Key Projects

  • Implement distributed tracing and observability for GraphQL-based systems.
  • Containerize core services to improve scalability and operational efficiency.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or data systems development.
  • Strong experience designing and optimizing GraphQL schemas and APIs .
  • Experience with JavaScript / TypeScript, Node.js, or Python .

  • Aurora MySQL

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

description:

We are looking for a CRM Automation Specialist to build, implement, and optimize CRM workflows, automations, pipelines, and funnel sequences for our clients.

This role is focused on turning client sales and follow-up processes into structured, functional CRM systems. We are looking for someone who is hands-on, detail-oriented, and experienced in building automations, managing lead flow, and supporting conversion-focused funnels across platforms such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Keap, or similar tools with strong pipeline and workflow automation capabilities.

  • Review and troubleshoot workflow issues, automation conflicts, contact flow errors, and delivery problems
  • Monitor CRM and funnel performance, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements to workflow logic and follow-up structure
  • Work closely with Account Managers and internal teams to align CRM builds with client goals and campaign strategy
  • Document workflow logic and setup structure clearly for internal visibility and scalability
  • Join client calls when needed to explain CRM setups and automation logic in a clear and simple way


The Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Hands-on experience building automations and workflows in platforms such as GoHighLevel , HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Keap, or similar tools
  • Strong understanding of CRM workflows, pipelines, automations, lead nurturing, and funnel progression
  • Experience building appointment-based funnels, reminders, follow-up sequences, and re-engagement flows
  • Ability to work with tags, conditions, wait steps, opportunity movement, and lifecycle-based automations

title: Refunds Specialist
description:
ROLE

Property Leads is a fast-growing startup building cutting-edge lead generation and data solutions for the real estate industry. We're a lean, high-impact team of 20, solving complex problems at the intersection of technology, data, and growth.


We’re looking for an exceptional communicator and lead prospector capable of achieving remarkable results in the Refunds Specialist role at Property Leads. The successful candidate in this role must know that this is not a traditional 9 am to 5 pm job– evening and weekend work are required, and 40-60 hours per week are required.


You’ll work closely with our Senior Refund Coordinator and Customer Success Manager to collect data through text, phone calls, and email communication to process refunds accurately and efficiently.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to confirm the status of selling their home.
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to determine if they own the home.
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to confirm if a mobile home for sale does/does not come with the land it sits on.
  • Move all prospects to the proper pipeline stage via CRM throughout the day.
  • Maintain a clear, up-to-date, and accurate pipeline in our CRM.
  • Follow up diligently and consistently with sellers over extended periods.
  • Document all interactions with prospects and clients in the CRM's “notes” section, escalating to Support or the Senior Refunds Coordinator as needed.
  • Process refunds with integrity, according to the refund policy.


RESULTS

  • Reach sellers promptly to help determine the outcome of declining/approving a refund request.
  • All sellers are promptly followed up with.
  • There is an effective line of communication between this role and the Senior Refunds Coordinator in which all necessary information is communicated promptly.
  • Continuously improve communication skills (Crucial Conversations book, etc.)
  • All internal communication cycles are adequately followed.


REQUIREMENTS

  • Proven work experience with cold calling or phone sales.
  • Proven work experience with text messaging/emailing in English.
  • You must enjoy being on the phone and speaking to sellers.
  • Excellent communication skills, including listening and facing conflict head-on.
  • Excellent at building rapport.
  • Willing to work in a fast-paced environment and rapidly grow.
  • Open to learning new processes in cold calling/seller outreach.
  • Self-sufficient and able to properly manage one’s own time.
  • Well-organized and able to maintain a pipeline that the Refunds Coordinator and sales Manager can observe and understand.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Experience as a real estate investor is preferred but optional.
  • Must pass written and verbal exams.

title: AI Engineer

We are hiring two AI/LLM Engineers (one Mid-Level and one Senior) to join a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and quality engineers. In this role, you will contribute to an enterprise-grade, end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system.

title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.


Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.


Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.


Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.


Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.


Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.


Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.


What We’re Looking For


  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.


Nice-to-Have Skills


  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).


Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.

  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles
