title: Technical product manager (temporary contract)
description:
About You
You are a technically fluent, execution-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and stakeholder management. You communicate clearly, operate independently, and bring empathy to every interaction.
You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.
You feel comfortable owning a product backlog, onboarding API partners, presenting to a Change Advisory Board, and collaborating directly with clients to troubleshoot issues. You connect teams, drive accountability, and ensure initiatives move forward successfully.
Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Strong fluency in Agile and Scrum, including backlog ownership, sprint ceremonies, user story writing, and acceptance criteria definition.
Strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, champion quality, and drive the Definition of Done.
Proven ability to act as a liaison between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners.
Excellent technical communication skills, translating business requirements into technical language for audiences at all levels.
Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and authentication concepts, including error handling, log review, and defect triage.
Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure Dev Ops for backlog management, issue tracking, and release coordination.
Strong documentation skills covering requirements, epics, user stories, workflows, and integration touchpoints.
Active user of AI tools and copilots, with a practical focus on improving workflows and engineering productivity.
Highly self-managed, with strong ownership and proactive risk identification across concurrent initiatives.
Strong empathy and curiosity for customer and partner problems, with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.
Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria aligned with business needs.
Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team’s single point of accountability for quality and progress.
Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners.
Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests.
Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams.
Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues.
Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers.
Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities.
Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions.
Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.
Qualifications
Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure Dev Ops for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues.
Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams.
Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.
Additional Information
About Us
We Are Engineered Different.
At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Senior content manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting Move Up Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.To be more specific, you will:Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets

Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and i Gaming innovations
Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
Has i Gaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
Ownership mindset over site and content performance
Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process ✅1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with Move Up Media
Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What’s in it for youA full time remote work environment.
A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!Move Up MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of i Gaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our approachWe focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.

title: Key account manager
description:
NOTA:
Queremos ser muito sinceros: devido ao nível de desafio, sabemos que trabalhar na Wareclouds não é para todos. Se você é uma pessoa que busca se desafiar ao máximo, resolver problemas difíceis e trabalhar no ritmo de um time de alto desempenho, este lugar é para você.A única forma de se sentir confortável em um ambiente de alto desempenho é que isso seja exatamente o que você está procurando. Caso contrário, nossa cultura pode não ser a ideal para vocêAcerca a Wareclouds
Olhe ao seu redor por um momento. Grande parte do que você vê foi impactado por dados, processos e algoritmos. No entanto, muitas operações ainda se baseiam em métodos tradicionais e não aproveitam ao máximo as capacidades tecnológicas atuais. Na Wareclouds, estamos desafiando esse modelo.Imagine um mundo em que as operações logísticas acontecem de forma fluida, sem atritos e com precisão milimétrica, apoiadas por análises de dados robustas e automações inteligentes. Na Wareclouds, tornamos isso realidade, utilizando tecnologias avançadas para otimizar operações logísticas e apoiar a tomada de decisões.Não estamos apenas transformando a forma como as empresas operam, também estamos construindo um futuro mais eficiente e orientado por dados. Se você quer fazer parte dessa transformação, junte-se a nós!Juntos, estamos redefinindo como as empresas operam e tomam decisões baseadas em dados!O que estamos procurando?
Dado o crescimento acelerado da Wareclouds no Brasil e a necessidade de maior eficiência na gestão de clientes enterprise, estamos em busca do/a nosso/a próximo/a Key Account Manager (KAM) Estratégico, que será responsável pela gestão, expansão e retenção de grandes contas, atuando como dono(a) da estratégia e do relacionamento de longo prazo.Essa pessoa terá um papel central na estruturação e crescimento das operações, na expansão geográfica, na governança estratégica das contas e na garantia de que os clientes enterprise cresçam de forma sustentável, alinhados aos objetivos de longo prazo da Wareclouds.Quais seriam suas responsabilidades?
Atuar como principal ponto focal de grandes contas, garantindo relacionamento estratégico e de longo prazo
Liderar a estratégia de crescimento das contas enterprise, com foco em expansão de volume, regiões e operações
Coordenar operações distribuídas em múltiplos Centros de Distribuição, garantindo padronização, eficiência e qualidade
Planejar e acompanhar a abertura de novas operações e centros, em parceria com os times de Operações, Produto e Tecnologia

Atuar fortemente em retenção, antecipando riscos e oportunidades de crescimento
Traduzir necessidades dos clientes em demandas claras para os times internos

Formação superior em Administração, Comunicação, Economia, Logística ou áreas correlatas
Experiência prévia como Key Account, Account Manager ou função similar, gerenciando grandes contas

Forte capacidade de pensamento estratégico aliado à execução
Perfil analítico, orientado a dados e métricas

Alta autonomia, senso de dono(a) e capacidade de priorização
Conforto em ambientes de ritmo acelerado e alta performanceDesejável

title: Service Engineer
description: Job Summary:The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.In this role, your responsibilities will be: Onboard Service Execution: Provide support, supervise, and test/troubleshoot field issues onboard vessels and various offshore units. This includes sailing/staying onboard vessels/units while handling services and warranty-related matters. Execute the requested service in the best possible way to meet customer deadlines and expectations. Commissioning and On-site Sea Trial Execution: Test, calibrate, and verify the system configuration within Emerson ICMS software and other ICMS supplies and Emerson marine products. Deliver and obtain approvals from the Shipyard, Owner, and Class during sea trials. Reports / Administrative Activities: Clearly written work reports must be completed upon returning from trips, in English, detailing all follow-up points. Onboard service reports must be signed by customers. Stay up to date on administrative responsibilities such as maintaining internal service reports and internal records in a timely manner. Participation in FAT Tests: Participate in customer equipment workshop tests, together with project engineering, the end customer, and Class. Training: Participate in all trainings and meetings as required by Emerson. Participate in, observe, and comply with the company's health and safety guidelines and contribute to a safe work environment. Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates. Provide basic on-site/onboard training for customers/crews.Who You Are: You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.For this role, you will need: Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus. 3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment. Experience dealing with customers in high-pressure environments. Availability to work overtime, as needed. Computer literacy and experience with MS Office and Excel. Fluency in English and Portuguese, written and spoken. Work location: Rio de Janeiro.Our Culture and Commitment to You: At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We promote an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, because we know great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe that diverse teams, working together, are key to driving growth and delivering business results. We recognize the importance of employee well-being. We offer medical, dental, pharmacy, and Wellhub (Gympass) benefits; life insurance; credit union; private pension plan; recognition programs, and much more. Our people-focused culture includes resource groups and an employee assistance program, as well as extended parental leave (both maternal and paternal) as part of our Empresa Cidadã certification.

description: Estamos em busca de umCoordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TIque será responsável por coordenar as atividades de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais e o funcionamento estável e seguro dos ambientes corporativos e críticos da empresa de energia. Atuar como elo entre a estratégia definida pela Superintendência e a execução pelas equipes técnicas, assegurando conformidade regulatória, resiliência operacional e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio. Seus desafios serão:Liderar a equipe de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura, promovendo integração entre processos, pessoas e tecnologia. Implementar e manter políticas, normas e controles de segurança alinhados a frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST CSF, IEC 62443, LGPD e regulamentos setoriais (ANEEL, ONS). Coordenar atividades de gestão de vulnerabilidades, hardening, monitoração e resposta a incidentes (TI e OT). Apoiar a operação do SNOC (Security & Network Operations Center) e a interface com o CSIRT, garantindo tempos de resposta adequados a incidentes. Supervisionar a gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM), controles de rede, servidores e sistemas críticos. Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de projetos de infraestrutura de TI, assegurando que os requisitos de segurança estejam integrados desde o desenho. Garantir continuidade operacional e planos de recuperação de desastres (BCP/DRP). Promover campanhas de conscientização em segurança e boas práticas para colaboradores e fornecedores. Interagir com áreas regulatórias, auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de conformidade. Reportar periodicamente à Superintendência o status da segurança, principais riscos e indicadores de desempenho.O que é necessário você ter:Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou especialização em Segurança da Informação (obrigatório). Certificações valorizadas: CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CompTIA Security+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Security, ou IEC 62443. Experiência comprovada em: Segurança da Informação: gestão de vulnerabilidades, SNOC, IAM, políticas, auditorias. Infraestrutura de TI: administração de servidores (Windows/Linux), redes, storage, gestão de ambientes críticos. Resiliência Operacional: continuidade de negócios, backup, DRP. Vivência em empresas de energia ou setores críticos será diferencial. Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial aplicada à Segurança da Informação (uso de IA para detecção de ameaças, análise comportamental e automação de resposta a incidentes).O que temos para você:Vale Alimentação; Vale Refeição; Assistência médica; Assistência odontológica; Auxilio farmácia; Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados; Previdência privada; Wellhub; Seguro de vida; Convênio com empresas parceiras; Programa de treinamentos.

Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes; Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses; Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management; Support audits and evaluations of training service providers; Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required; Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred; Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage); Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable; Fluent English (minimum intermediate level); Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities; Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.Benefits Meal and food allowances; Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay); Life Insurance; Annual Bonus; Private Pension Plan; Childcare Allowance.Note This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens. MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Nurse Offshore
description:
Position: Nurse Offshore

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.


Job Purpose

The Offshore Nurse is responsible for leading onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness, providing medical assistance, and promoting a healthy working environment and overall wellbeing for all personnel onboard the FPSO. The role also ensures compliance with corporate health standards and applicable regulations.


Key Responsibilities

Lead onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness and proper medical assistance at all times;

Activate MEDEVAC procedures in accordance with remote medical support instructions;

Maintain updated inventory of medicines and medical supplies, ensuring availability and preventing expired items onboard;

Liaise with onshore remote medical support for diagnosis guidance and prescription of medicines for injured or ill personnel;

Support the preparation and implementation of rescue plans (confined space and working at height);

Request calibration, hydrostatic testing, and replacement of hospital equipment and first aid kits to ensure prompt emergency response;

Inspect catering services and facilities, including food storage, conservation, preparation, and accommodation cleanliness, maintaining proper health inspection records;

Participate in auditing and certification processes related to health services;

Collect and monitor fresh and potable water samples, conducting analysis onboard and coordinating onshore testing in accordance with procedures;

Provide First Aidtraining to designated first aid teams onboard;

Prepare and maintain medical documentation and reports (Health Initial Report, Logbook, corporate reports, and other required documents);

Implement and maintain the Health Service Waste Management Program and ensure proper recordkeeping.


Requirements

Degree in Nursing with valid COREN registration;

Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

Advanced life support and emergency care training;

Experience with occupational health routines and health surveillance;

Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);

Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently onboard;

Knowledge of Brazilian maritime and health regulations is an advantage.


Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance


Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Master Data Modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location

Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
  • Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
  • Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
  • Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
  • Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
  • Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
  • Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
  • Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
  • Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
  • Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
  • Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.G., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
  • Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.


Desired Qualifications

  • Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
  • Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.


Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.


This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams.


You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
  • Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
  • Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
  • Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
  • Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
  • Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
  • Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
  • Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
  • Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
  • Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Acompanhamento e análise de alterações na legislação tributária e consultoria interna;
  • Atuação estratégica junto a assessores externos na elaboração de pareceres e acompanhamento de fiscalizações;
  • Atendimento a auditorias e controle de processos tributários;
  • Estruturação denovas atividades, serviços e novos empreendimentos multiuso, incluindo pesquisa da legislação;
  • Análise contratual e simulação da alternativa fiscal mais eficiente;
  • Atuação em projetos de M&A, com foco em reestruturações societárias preparatórias para aquisições e vendas de ativos;
  • Identificação de oportunidades e condução da implementação de projetos, a fim de garantir a maximização dos resultados e a redução de riscos fiscais.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis ou Direito;
  • Especialização na área tributária;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Experiência sólida na área Tributária;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação com interfaces em projetos multidisciplinares.


Informações adicionais


O Que Temos Para Você

title: Desenvolvedor .Net

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

Plano de Saúde;

Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Pessoa Analista De Controles Internos Sr.
description:
Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Desta forma, as soluções customizadas de Autoprodução de energia Solar, Eficiência Energética, Subestações, HVAC, Geração de vapor, Consultoria e Gerenciamento de Energia atendem toda a cadeia otimizando a relação com a energia em diversos setores como Indústria, Shopping Centers, Varejo Multisites, Aeroportos, Hospitais, entre outros.

Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.

Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

Missão do Cargo

Garantir a integridade operacional e regulatória da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento, monitoramento e aprimoramento contínuo dos controles internos, promovendo a mitigação de riscos e a conformidade com normas internas e externas.

Principais Atividades

1. Identificar e avaliar riscos operacionais, financeiros e de conformidade associados às atividades da empresa de energia renovável.

2. Executar auditorias internas periódicas para avaliar a eficácia dos controles internos e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.

3. Manter-se atualizado sobre regulamentações do setor, garantindo aderência aos controles internos.

4. Fornecer treinamento e orientação aos colaboradores sobre práticas e controles internos, fomentando cultura de conformidade.

5. Desenvolver protocolos para tratamento de incidentes de não conformidade, investigando irregularidades e definindo medidas corretivas.

6. Preparar relatórios regulares sobre desempenho dos controles internos, com análises e recomendações à alta administração.

7. Colaborar com TI para integrar controles internos aos sistemas corporativos, promovendo abordagem sistêmica.

8. Avaliar eficiência e eficácia dos processos de negócio, propondo melhorias para otimização e redução de riscos.

9. Facilitar auditorias externas, garantindo fornecimento de documentação e informações necessárias.

10. Efetuar os testes e análises de acordo com as instruções do Grupo para o programa global de controles internos.

Requisitos

  • Superior completo: Administração, Economia, Contabilidade e áreas afins;
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado;
  • Pacote office Intermediário.


Desejável

  • Especialização (Pós-Graduação/MBA) Administração, Economia, Contabilidade e áreas afins;
  • Pacote Office –Avançado
  • Conhecimento em processos de controles internos
  • Experiência em Big 4

Local de Trabalho

Rio de Janeiro/RJ - Brasil

A ENGIE valoriza e estimula uma cultura de diversidade e inclusão, com orientação para igualdade entre as pessoas, respeito pela vida privada de todos e é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e assédio.

title: Latam-Focused Research Intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.

Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship

Position Description

We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment . This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.


Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered .

Main Responsibilities

· Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.

· Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.

· Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.

· Track the performance and movements of financial assets.

· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

· Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

· Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

· Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

· Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

· Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

· Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

· Clear and structured written communication skills.

· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

· Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.G., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

· Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

· Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Senior Supply Chain Analyst
description:
The Senior Supply Chain Analyst will be responsible for managing procurement activities, supplier performance, contracts, and materials flow to support operational demands. The role requires close interaction with operations, engineering, logistics, finance, and external suppliers, ensuring timely delivery, cost optimization, and compliance with internal and external requirements.


The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.


**Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.


Duties


  • Manage procurement processes from requisition to delivery, including RFQs, negotiations, purchase orders, and follow-up
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with local and international suppliers
  • Analyze costs, lead times, and supply risks to support sourcing decisions
  • Support contract management, including commercial terms, service levels, and compliance
  • Coordinate logistics, importation, and exportation processes when applicable
  • Monitor supplier performance and propose continuous improvement actions
  • Support inventory control, critical materials analysis, and stock optimization
  • Prepare reports, KPIs, and dashboards to support management decision-making
  • Ensure compliance with internal procedures, HSE requirements, and applicable regulations


Required


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related field
  • Advanced English skills (written and spoken)
  • Strong experience in procurement and supply chain operations, preferably in industrial, offshore, oil & gas, or logistics environments
  • Microsoft Office proficiency, including Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, and SharePoint
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Experience with ERP systems is a plus (e.G., Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, SAP, Oracle)

title: Gerente De Loja
description:
A CK é uma marca norte-americana fundada em 1968 na cidade de Nova York, e que manteve sua iconicidade e atemporalidade até os dias atuais. Este nome se expandiu ao redor do mundo, e por isso hoje está presente em vários países, inclusive no Brasil.


Nacionalmente contamos com +2.000 pontos de venda, além de termos nossa matriz corporativa presente na cidade de São Paulo, e contarmos com 2 centros de distribuição: um em Cotia/SP, e outro em Serra/ES.


Nosso propósito é “impulsionar a moda para o bem”, além de termos como visão “sermos a marca de fashion lifestyle mais admirada do mundo!”. Para isso, temos alguns valores como individualidade, integridade, paixão, parceria e responsabilidade.


Além disso, a CK é conhecida por seu grande compromisso com Diversidade e Inclusão! Todas as nossas vagas são direcionadas a todos os públicos, valorizando a pluralidade de identidades e experiências. Por isso, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas negras, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência, indígenas, de diferentes gerações, e outros tipos de diversidade. Aqui, você é uma pessoa bem-vinda para ser quem é (lembra do nosso valor de #individualidade? =D)!


Como Será Seu Dia a Dia Aqui Reportando-se ao Supervisor Regional, sua principal responsabilidade será promover a venda de produtos CK, atingindo o volume de vendas previsto, visando à conquista de novos clientes e a fidelização dos clientes atuais.


Além disso você também será responsável por:

  • Fazer a gestão completa da loja, incluindo pessoas, processos e produtos.
  • Responsável pelo Recrutamento e Seleção da loja.
  • Buscar incessantemente o alcance e superação das metas mensais, realizando a gestão dos resultados e indicadores de desempenho.
  • Treinamento, acompanhamento e desenvolvimento da equipe.
  • Responsável por manter o clima favorável às atividades de venda, garantindo a implementação, execução e repasse das informações para todos os colaboradores, através das normas e procedimentos da empresa.

Presencial – Nova Friburgo/RJ

title: Data Engineer - Especialista
description:
Breve descrição:

Responsável por construir e manter todo o pipeline e soluções de dados, garantindo a gestão,

otimização, monitoramento, armazenamento e distribuição de dados em toda a organização. - Extrair os dados de diversas fontes para ingestão nas plataformas de Big Data, Bancos Relacionais e Não Relacionais.


Principais atividades:

- Assegurar que os dados sejam apropriados, acessíveis e disponíveis

- Garantir o alinhamento entre os dados operacionais e o modelo de dados requerido e desejável

- Otimizar a performance e escalabilidade - Implementar métodos para melhorar a confiabilidade e a qualidade dos dados

- Combinar informações brutas de diferentes fontes para criar formatos consistentes e legíveis por máquina

- Desenvolver e testar arquiteturas que permitem a extração e transformação de dados para

modelagem preditiva ou prescritiva

- Identificar oportunidades para aquisição de dados

- Desenvolver ferramentas e programas analíticos

- Contribuir na disseminação de uma cultura de Data-DrivenDecision na companhia, fazendo

interface entre áreas técnicas e as diversas áreas de negócio

- Disponibilizar dados para os Data Scientist e Data Analyst

- Atuar de forma muito próxima ao desenvolvimento de software, pois frequentemente trabalhará com os dados extraídos diretamente de sistemas origem;

- Apoiar na definição da solução arquitetural mais adequada ao projeto de automação, levando em conta as melhores práticas da companhia e as tecnologias disponível.


Conhecimentos, experiência, formação:

- Experiencia em implantação de pipeline de dados (de ingestão até disponibilização de dados para tomada de decisão), incluindo etapas de Data Quality e Data Lineage.

- Conhecimento técnico de estruturas de dados (Bancos Relacionais, Não Relacionais e Big Data) - Database Management

- Data Mining - Data Modeling

- Conhecimento de soluções de dados em Cloud (GCP, Azure, OCI, etc)

- Linguagens de programação (SQL, Shell Script, Pyhton, Scala, Java, Spark, etc.)

- Experiencia em desenvolvimento de software

- Metodologias desenvolvimento lean/agile

- Conhecimento conceitual de dados e analytics, como modelagem, ETL, ferramentas

de geração de relatórios, governança de dados, data warehousing, dados estruturados e não

estruturados;

- Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Informática, Engenharia ou áreas afins;

- Desejável Especializações nas áreas de BI, Analytics, Cloud Computing, Big Data, Análise Avançada de Dados.

title: Executivo De Vendas Mid-Market
description:
Na ADP, somos movidos pelo seu sucesso. Envolvemos seus talentos e perspectivas únicos. Acolhemos suas ideias para fazer as coisas de modo diferente e melhor. Nós apoiamos seus esforços para realizar, aprender e crescer. Se o sucesso te motiva, você pertence à ADP.


Nos esforçamos para que cada interação seja motivada pelos nossos valores CENTRAIS: Conhecimento e Visão, Integridade é Tudo, Excelência na Prestação de Serviços, Inovação Inspiradora, Cada Pessoa Conta, Orientação a Resultados e Responsabilidade Social.


Nossa cultura acolhe diversas perspectivas e cria um lugar onde as carreiras podem florescer. Nós respeitamos e valorizamos as diferenças com oportunidades iguais de emprego, independentemente de raça, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, cultura, deficiência ou status social.

Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso. Faça parte do nosso time!


RESUMO DA VAGA


Nós estamos procurando por um executivo de vendas para os nossos contratos com empresas globais e multinacionais. Esta pessoa será responsável pela prospecção de novos clientes no Estado do Rio de Janeiro, geração de novos leads na indústria de serviço em empresas mid-market e pelo relacionamento com executivos de alto escalão.

É necessário conhecimento aprofundado dos produtos da ADP e seus escopos versus forças/fraquezas de nossos competidores. Além disso, é importante o estabelecimento de relacionamento aprofundado com prospects e clientes.


RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolver plano de negócios anual, determinando metas de vendas e ações para o atingimento da cota estabelecida;
    alcançar e superar cotaatravés da carteira designada;
